  • Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation.   • Ship agents and multi-step workflows for account research, success planning, scoping, status reporting, and customer onboarding. Package them as skills and plugins for non-engineers using Claude, Claude in Slack, and GitLab Duo Agent Platform.
  • Build MCP servers and connectors for governed access to GitLab, Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, Thought Industries, Gong, Snowflake, and other enterprise systems. Add evaluations, tracing, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints to keep internal and customer-facing agents measurable, auditable, and safe with customer data.
  • Evolve the CX Application Platform's gateway, Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, including Elastic Container Service (ECS), Relational Database Service (RDS), and Lambda, Terraform configuration, application scaffold, and deployment path. Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.
  • Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.
  • Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.
  • Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and operating production software, owning multi-quarter work from ambiguity to production, choosing reusable platform solutions over one-off customization where appropriate, and designing for handoff.
  • Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.
  • Experience building with large language models (LLMs) beyond chat, including tool use, MCP servers, agent loops, context and retrieval design, prompt and workflow design, and evaluations.
  • Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Flask and TypeScript skills with Vue or React, including application programming interface (API) design, authentication, authorization, and secure handling of customer and business data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.
  • Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.
  • Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.

We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; you don't need to meet every nice-to-have to apply.

CX Platform Engineering builds and runs CX Applications for Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training. We own the CX Application Platform's gateway and infrastructure alongside our application portfolio: GitLab University, the Foundational Onboarding Agent in GitLab Duo Agent Platform, Congregate, PS Compass, and Customer Wins. We build the first version with the people doing the work, turn what we learn into a reusable pattern, then hand it off so it runs without us. jobs.description:
Clover is reinventing health insurance by working to keep people healthier.

We value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of healthcare. Clover's engineering team is empathetic, caring, and supportive. We are deliberate about the team and culture we are building. We seek engineers who are strong in their own work and care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

We are looking for a senior software engineer to make Counterpart Health's existing customer-facing platform agentic. You will build applied AI systems that retrieve relevant information, call tools, and help healthcare users complete meaningful work. You will work with engineers, data scientists, and healthcare professionals, with ownership across data pipelines, backend services, model behavior, and the user experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that multiply human efforts.
  • Build and maintain customer-facing agentic AI software, with ownership from data ingestion through to the user interface.
    • Develop retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG, pipelines for ingestion, ETL, storage, indexing, retrieval, and context assembly.
    • Build agent workflows that call tools and use application services, with clear permissions, execution limits, and human review where needed.
    • Choose models, storage, retrieval, and orchestration patterns based on product needs and measured results.
  • Protect PHI and tenant boundaries across data, prompts, retrieval, tools, and outputs in a HIPAA-regulated environment.
  • Use customer feedback and failure analysis to improve answers and tool execution.
  • Measure and improve quality, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Master new tools and technologies to solve concrete user problems while keeping the system simple enough for the team to maintain and operate.
  • Help the team define development practices that support fast iteration and quality, including tests and documentation of key implementations.
  • Work with Product Managers and operational staff to choose useful workflows, define success, and deliver features to customers.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have personally owned a production agentic system used by external customers. You can explain your contribution across ingestion, ETL, storage, retrieval, the tool-calling loop, inference, and UI integration.
  • You have used evaluations to improve a live system. Can explain the test data, failure categories, release criteria, and limits of automated or LLM-as-judge scoring.
  • You bring senior software engineering experience and can write, test, debug, and operate the application code behind an AI feature. Python and TypeScript or JavaScript experience are useful, as is comparable experience in another production language.
  • You have experience with SQL, APIs, data pipelines, and cloud services such as GCP or AWS.
  • You have handled practical LLM limitations, such as context-window limits, unsupported answers, retrieval failures, and incorrect tool calls.
  • Experience with healthcare or another regulated industry is a plus. Experience with tools such as LangGraph, Langfuse, pgvector, or OpenSearch is useful, but we care more about your engineering decisions and production results than a particular framework. Using AI coding assistants, building demos, or shipping internal tools alone does not meet the production AI experience required for this role.

You will love this job if:

  • You are curious about how systems work and use pragmatic engineering to solve complicated problems. You test whether an AI approach improves the workflow and use simpler software when it is the better choice.
  • You enjoy a collaborative environment where you help define priorities and own delivery. You bring clarity to ambiguity and change your view when new evidence calls for it.
  • You take responsibility for what reaches customers. You investigate broken behavior, fix the cause, and improve the tests and evaluations that should catch it.
  • You care about what good technology can do for people and want to work with healthcare professionals on tools they can trust.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.Â 
  • Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

jobs.description:

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more atÂ bitwarden.com.Â 

As a Senior Database Engineer at Bitwarden you will work with our Engineering teams to lead the design, development, and continual tuning and maintenance of our database systems.Â  You will serve as a technical leader for database query design and the optimization of our existing queries, scripts, and programs.Â  You will support the software development process and contribute directly to the culture of quality within Bitwarden through process improvements, team outreach, and mentoring. To ensure success as a Senior Database Engineer, you should exhibit knowledge of best practices in database management and experience in a similar role. A top-notch Senior Database Engineer will be someone whose database management skills translate into the efficient flow of information throughout an organization.

This is an all-remote team and we are looking for someone located in the U.S. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain and enhance the performance of existing database scripts, queries, and other database objects
  • Assist engineering teams in designing new database implementations that meet the organization's data security, storage, and performance needs
  • Tune existing database scripts and queries for optimal performance and data security
  • Establish database observability practices and monitor databases and related systems to ensure optimized performance alongside operations staff
  • Partner with other engineers to develop new scripts and queries that support company growth
  • Review database and user reports as well as system information
  • Perform debugging procedures on database scripts and systems, including as a part of incident response
  • Mentor engineers and provide them with technical support
  • Adhere to best practices in securely accessing, storing, backing up, and archiving data
  • Document processes related to database design, configuration, and performance
  • Keep abreast of developments and best practices in database engineering
  • Participate in code reviews and learn and spread technical knowledge amongst the engineering organization

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

Must haves:

  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL: execution plans, indexing, locking and blocking, and query tuning on very large tables
  • Experience reviewing other engineersâ database code (schema changes, stored procedures, queries, migrations) and giving clear, constructive feedback that developers act on
  • Experience making schema changes safely on live systems: backward-compatible migrations, zero-downtime deployments, and knowing which changes block
  • Experience operating a large, busy cloud-hosted database in production (Azure SQL preferred; equivalent experience on another managed platform is welcome)
  • Ability to diagnose performance problems with evidence, using tools such as Query Store, execution plans, and wait and blocking analysis
  • Excellent problem-solving skills: you might not know all the answers, but you know how to find and communicate the solution
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining database findings to developers, SRE and support
  • Proficiency using source control and working through pull requests
  • Around 5 years of experience in database engineering, or equivalent depth on a large production system

But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness

We're looking for a hands-on Managing Assistant for our Head of Web: someone who can genuinely take work off her plate, not just coordinate it, and who is confident working directly in our web tool stack (WordPress, CMS, web tech).

This is a hands-on, hybrid role: operational and administrative support for the Head of Web, plus running smaller web projects of your own — more doing than overseeing.

You'll independently lead smaller website projects, coordinate designers and developers, communicate directly with clients and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to our quality standards.

At the same time, you'll work closely with our Head of Web, helping coordinate larger projects, prepare client meetings, follow up on deliverables and keep day-to-day operations running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who can think ahead, bring structure to a busy environment and take things off the Head of Web's plate without needing constant direction.

The position starts at around 50% (roughly 20 hours per week), with daily check-ins and the potential to grow as responsibilities increase.

  • Act as the main point of contact for clients on your assigned projects.

  • Coordinate designers, developers and other specialists to ensure smooth project delivery.

  • Manage project timelines, budgets and scope, identifying potential risks early.

  • Coordinate testing, quality assurance and website launches.

  • Support budget tracking, resource planning and project reporting.

  • Coordinate communication between clients, project teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of operational and administrative tasks to free up the Head of Web for strategic priorities and client relationships.

Client Communication & Coordination

  • Handle day-to-day client requests and coordinate their implementation with the team.

  • Support ongoing client relationships by ensuring reliable delivery and responsiveness.

  • Recognize when issues require escalation and involve the Head of Web at the right time.

Project Management Experience

  • Some experience running or closely supporting website projects (agency or consultancy a plus); full PM seniority is not required.

  • Ability to independently manage smaller projects while supporting larger, more complex initiatives.

  • Strong organizing skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, including designers and developers.

  • Good understanding of project budgets, timelines, scope and change requests.

Technical & Digital Understanding

  • Solid understanding of website development processes, from design to launch.

  • Basic understanding of UX, digital marketing, SEO and website analytics.

  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity, documentation and daily workflows.

Communication & Organisation

  • Fluent professional German and strong English communication skills.

  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with clients.

  • Strong prioritisation skills and a structured, solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate issues.

  • Proactive in following up on tasks and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

What makes you a fit

  • You bring structure. You enjoy organising information, managing priorities and keeping multiple projects moving.

  • You're a strong communicator. You know how to keep clients informed, manage expectations and communicate professionally.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the variety of agency work, likes taking responsibility and gets satisfaction from making complex workflows run smoothly.

You'll have the opportunity to manage your own projects while working closely with an experienced Head of Web, gaining exposure to larger enterprise clients and more complex digital initiatives.

Perks
